description: Impeccable design detector: immediate-tier checks after Edit/Write on UI files, full-rule deep pass on Stop.

environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: chewielabs (GitHub org; repo `chewielabs/boba_fetch`)
**Cloud provider(s)**: AWS (ECS Fargate, ECR, CDK/IAM/SSM per infra/); Vercel (SvelteKit orchestration layer)
**Repository visibility**: internal (chewielabs/boba_fetch, per gh)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Env vars validated via per-subsystem Zod schemas (BOBA_* secrets, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, STORYBLOK_MANAGEMENT_TOKEN, FIGMA_CLIENT_SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN, GitHub App private key); `.env`/`.env.*`/`secrets.env` gitignored, `.env.example` is the template only

**Default / protected branches**: `main` is the default branch and is protected (rulesets `1 Approval required- All repos` and `protect-default-branch-all-repos`, both active; classic protected-branches list also shows `main`)
**CI/CD deploy targets**: AWS ECS Fargate via `bun run deploy:agent` (build+tag+ECR push) and CDK (`infra/`: `npx cdk diff` / `npx cdk deploy`); Vercel for the SvelteKit layer (`bun run build`)
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: chewielabs/boba_fetch (origin: github.com:chewielabs/boba_fetch.git) and its remote(s) only, scoped internal per gh visibility
**Trusted internal domains**: chewielabs.atlassian.net (Jira instance referenced in .env.example as BOBA_JIRA_BASE_URL)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: Jira (chewielabs.atlassian.net, service-account Basic auth + webhook shared secret), GitHub App (RS256 JWT → installation tokens, repo clone/push/PR), Storyblok Management API, Figma OAuth
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: `.env`, `.env.*` (excluding `.env.example`), `secrets.env`, `src/cli/secrets.ts`/`secrets.test.ts`, `src/mcp-servers/shared/secrets.ts`/`secrets-file.ts`/`secrets.test.ts`, `.boba/docs/guides/audit-internal-endpoint-shared-secret.md` — share only with audiences cleared at the named+specifics bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources under `infra/` (AWS CDK stack: VPC, ECS cluster, Fargate task def, ECR, IAM, SSM params); anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (AI agent orchestration: SvelteKit/Vercel + AWS ECS Fargate, per CLAUDE.md)
**Trusted repo**: chewielabs/boba_fetch (working directory) and its origin remote (github.com:chewielabs/boba_fetch.git), internal visibility
**Org-specific CLIs**: bun (primary package manager/build tool, not npm/pnpm); `npx cdk` for infra; `npx tsc` for Fargate type-check
**Routine under this repo**: bun install/dev/build/check, npx cdk diff/deploy under infra/, bun run deploy:agent for ECR image push
